title: Mediterranean seasonal planting calendar
summary: Chooses crops by Mediterranean seasons, heat, water, harvest time, and storage value.
content: Mediterranean seasonal planting calendar is a practical offline routine for planting calendar. Divide the year into cool wet season, warming spring, dry heat, and autumn recovery. List crops by water need, days to harvest, storage ability, edible part, and seed-saving value. Reserve peak heat for shade, drought-tolerant herbs, soil protection, and seed drying. Plant test rows before using all seed stock. Record sowing date, germination, heat damage, pests, harvest weight, and saved seed.
